description: Finish removing the dead BM2 Drizzle/Postgres layer. A prior session deleted lib/db/schema/* + drizzle.config.ts and dropped drizzle-*/postgres deps, but ~15 files still import live zod schemas/types that were co-located in those files, so BM2 no longer typechecks/builds. Re-home the live schemas off drizzle, rewire importers, then drop the tables and deps cleanly.
deviation_notes: Started from a half-applied, build-breaking working-tree deletion rather than a clean baseline.
